name: grove-shipper
description: Pirate Ship label-batch runner for Goldberry Grove (GOL-2271 B2). Drives the Pirate Ship web UI with a persistent Chromium profile: pulls a label batch from Odoo, uploads the CSV, price-checks every row, optionally buys, then reconciles tracking back into Odoo. The manual path (Odoo menu buttons) stays first-class and uses the same files and endpoints.
